gloss: to spread all over; to cover entirely; to pave

definitions.gloss: to spread all over; to cover entirely
definitions.explanation: To lay or spread something across an entire surface without gaps.

examples.japanese: {庭|にわ}に{砂利|じゃり}を{敷|し}き{詰|つ}めた。
examples.english: I spread gravel all over the garden.

examples.japanese: {床|ゆか}にタイルを{敷|し}き{詰|つ}める{工事|こうじ}が{始|はじ}まった。
examples.english: Work to tile the entire floor has begun.

examples.japanese: {部屋|へや}{一面|いちめん}に{畳|たたみ}を{敷|し}き{詰|つ}めた{和室|わしつ}は{落|お}ち{着|つ}く。
examples.english: A Japanese-style room with tatami mats covering the entire floor is calming.

notes:
CONSTRUCTION:
Compound verb from {敷|し}く (to spread, lay) + {詰|つ}める (to pack, fill). The {詰|つ}める component adds the sense of leaving no gaps.

TRANSITIVITY:
Transitive verb. The thing being spread takes を, and the surface takes に.

COMMON OBJECTS:
・{砂利|じゃり}を{敷|し}き{詰|つ}める - to spread gravel
・タイルを{敷|し}き{詰|つ}める - to lay tiles
・{畳|たたみ}を{敷|し}き{詰|つ}める - to cover with tatami
・{芝生|しばふ}を{敷|し}き{詰|つ}める - to cover with lawn
・レンガを{敷|し}き{詰|つ}める - to pave with bricks
